verdict.rationale: Angular ships the official Angular CLI (ng new, ng serve) and has AI-forward resources plus an llms.txt endpoint, but there is no evidence of AI-native CLI features (e.g., agentic commands, MCP integration, AI-assisted scaffolding) beyond general dev tooling. missing for 10: dedicated AI-native CLI commands/subcommands, evidence of agentic workflows or AI-specific CLI tooling, independent corroboration of AI-forward CLI capabilities.
